desc:
Welcome to Build A Spaceship and Fight Aliens!

Design your very own spaceship, blast through alien attacks, and travel across the galaxy!

Update:
- Rebirth 2 Items!
- Added Ice Fuel
- Added Ice Thruster
- Added Ice Wing
- Added Ice Blaster

Codes: 100Likes, 500Likes, 1000Likes, 5000Likes
Next code at 15,000 Likes!

🛠️ Build your dream ship using wings, thrusters, blasters, and more!
👽 Battle enemy aliens and earn coins every flight!
💰 Upgrade your ship with powerful new parts to fly even farther!
⚡ Rebirth to unlock rare and advanced spaceship parts!
⏰ Remember, your spaceship flies offline!

✨ How far can you travel through space before the aliens stop you?

Controls:
- Place & Shoot: Mouse Click
- Rotate: R
- Tilt: T
